name: Disputed KMCTC / Albatross Viet Nam relationship

attribution.legal_posture: The UN Panel reports a relationship to the canonical OFAC-designated KMCTC entity; Viet Nam disputed the Albatross relationship in the adjacent host-state response. This is review-only claim context for the relationship, not a separate entity profile.

caveats: The host-country response belongs alongside the Member State allegation; the relationship remains allegation-level.
Review-only relationship lead; keep it within review notes, separate from a KMCTC entity profile and the undisputed OFAC designation.
Viet Nam replied that its authorities reported zero DPRK workers or IT experts working in Albatross and gave contrary travel information about a related DPRK national.

statements: Albatross reportedly sourced developers from Korea National Development Investment Company and Korea Mangyongdae Computer Technology Corporation, both described as related to the Munitions Industry Department.
Mangyongdae was assessed as collaborating on IT projects with other DPRK entities and with DPRK cyber actors reporting to the Munitions Industry Department.

sources.support: Verifies Albatross, Korea National Development Investment Company, Mangyongdae, the reported sourcing relationship and Viet Nam response
